Indicator: OC1: Number of policy or regulatory reforms adopted by APEC economies as a result of U.S. support
OC2: Percentage of APEC economies adopting U.S.-aligned governance frameworks or best practices
OT1: Person hours of USG-supported training completed in trade and investment (EG.2-1)
OT2: Number of USG engagements jointly undertaken with private sector enterprises (PSE-1)
OC3: Percentage of APEC initiatives under US APEC-RISE that resulted in participating APEC economies aligning policies or practices with U.S.-backed reforms.
OT3: Number of US APEC-RISE initiatives referenced or reflected in official APEC policy documents, statements, or communiqués
OC4: Percentage of U.S. private sector partners reporting U.S.-supported technical assistance expanded opportunities for business growth and market engagement in APEC economies
OC5: Number of new connections or networks facilitated for the public or private sector through US APEC-RISE activities
OT4: Number of private sector enterprises that engaged with the USG to support U.S. Foreign Assistance objectives (PSE-2)
OC6: Number of local institutions demonstrating continued use of U.S.-supported tools, technical knowledge, or practices
OC7: Percentage of identified barriers to reform adoption successfully resolved through adaptive actions
OT5: Value of private sector resource commitments to support U.S. Foreign Assistance Objectives (PSE-4)
